title: FEFO batch expiry — use first
summary: Inventory now tracks expiry on batches. Near-expiry banner and per-item Use first labels show what to cook first. Receiving stock and restock capture expiry; POS sales and waste deduct soonest-expiring batches first (FEFO).
highlights: Receive PO / Restock: enter batch expiry date.
Stock row: click name for batches; Use first / Expired labels.
Banner: N batches near expiry with View list.
FEFO: sales and waste consume oldest-expiring batch first.
Sidebar badge counts low stock + near-expiry batches.
